newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romanian Foreign Minister Adrian Severin started official visit to Hungary to meet Prime Minister Gyula Horn and President Arpad Goncz and exchange ratification documents of a basic treaty the two states signed in September.
Severin met his counterpart Laszlo Kovacs to discuss implementation of treaty provisions and the opening of several Hungarian consular offices in Romanian cities.
* Changes in Romanian leadership made possible a relaunch of Romanian-Hungarian relations, Hungarian officials said.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea summoned Bucharest city officials to take steps and solve traffic problems due to heavy snowfalls over the past days.
* Weather is frosty across the country with scarce snowfalls.
* Several roads, mainly in eastern Romania, are still closed due to heavy snowfalls. The Fetesti-Cernavoda motorway is blocked, the transport ministry said.
It said railway traffic was slowed down with trains arriving up to 200 minutes behind schedule.
* The Black sea port of Constanta was still closed on Friday. The Danube Delta channel of Sulina was closed, too.
